hebrewText: לִ֣ינִי הַ/לַּ֗יְלָה וְ/הָיָ֤ה בַ/בֹּ֨קֶר֙ אִם יִגְאָלֵ֥/ךְ טוֹב֙ יִגְאָ֔ל וְ/אִם לֹ֨א יַחְפֹּ֧ץ לְ/גָֽאֳלֵ֛/ךְ וּ/גְאַלְתִּ֥י/ךְ אָנֹ֖כִי חַי יְהוָ֑ה שִׁכְבִ֖י עַד הַ/בֹּֽקֶר

tokens.bdb: to stop (usually over night); by implication, to stay permanently; hence (in a bad sense) to be obstinate (especially in words, to complain)
tokens.kjv: abide (all night), continue, dwell, endure, grudge, be left, lie all night, (cause to) lodge (all night, in, -ing, this night), (make to) murmur, remain, tarry (all night, that night).

tokens.bdb: properly, a twist (away of the light), i.e. night; figuratively, adversity
to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
tokens.kjv: beacon, [idiom] altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall, [phrase] follow, happen, [idiom] have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, [idiom] use.

tokens.bdb: properly, dawn (as the break of day); generally, morning

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).
